assets.gate_reason: S10b gothic family floor: GOTHIC_FLOOR (Vor Pride halls) is a native dark marble tile with no board picture. One opaque light gothic-floor master; rules unchanged (harmless walkable floor). No waiver.
assets.scope: Vor Pride L1-3 GOTHIC_FLOOR (and the base of its board doors, flat exits and book cells); nowhere else.

references.note: Native gothic hall floor: laid stone flags of a dark orc-pride keep. Keep the laid-flagstone hall identity but make it pale and calm; not this dark grey value.
Accepted board stone floor master: flat overhead matte finish, light value, low contrast and upper-left light. Not its warm sandstone palette and not its unjointed surface.

grid_contract.movement: Walkable; no movement rule, no speed bonus or penalty.
grid_contract.danger: None: no on_stand, no damage; must not look like a pit, water or a hazard.
grid_contract.interaction: None. Walls may be dug into this floor; the display follows via the existing re-tile repair.
grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed floor material; the exporter crops 2 checker parities (parity 1 about 12% darker) and uses it under the board doors, exits and books.

prompt_fields.subject: Walkable floor of a gothic stone hall seen from straight above: large square flagstones of pale cool grey limestone laid in a straight grid with thin dark joints, a faint worn polish and a few very soft grey-violet mineral veins; completely flat, calm and even.
prompt_fields.palette: Pale ash grey and light cool grey with a faint lavender-slate tint and a few slightly darker grey flags; light overall: clearly lighter than a dark slate wall; cooler and greyer than warm sandstone; muted, no black areas.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as flat walkable ground that game pieces stand on: pale and low contrast so characters stay readable; the thin joints stay subtle (no bold grid that competes with the board grid); it must NOT read as a pit, water, rubble or a hazard.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead floor material filling the whole square; about three to four flagstones across, even density, non-directional; no border, step, crack line, object, rune, symbol or shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Walkable floor only; harmless. Paint no pit, stairs, door, carpet, blood, character, symbol or text.

assets.gate_reason: S10b gothic family wall top: GOTHIC_WALL (and its wall3d variants and pillars) is a native dark spiked granite wall with no board picture. One opaque dark wall-top material; the exporter builds the N/E/S/W masks. Rules unchanged. No waiver.
assets.scope: Vor Pride L1-3 GOTHIC_WALL, GOTHIC_WALL1-5, _NORTH1-5, _PILLAR_81-5, _NORTH_SOUTH, _SOUTH, _SOUTH1-17, _SMALL_PILLAR, _PILLAR_2/4/6 (native wall3d layers dropped); nowhere else.

references.note: Native gothic granite wall: dark cut granite blocks. Keep the dark dressed-stone gothic identity as the top of a thick wall seen from above.
Accepted board wall-top material (TW5 mountain crest): an opaque overhead material of a solid blocking mass, its broad forms, scale and upper-left light. Not its natural rock or gold palette.

grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed wall-top material; the exporter crops fixed windows per neighbour mask, adds rims/sides and the separate gothic wall face on south edges toward open ground, 2 parities.

prompt_fields.subject: The top of a thick gothic keep wall seen from straight above: dark dressed slate-grey stone coping blocks, heavy and square-cut, laid in a tight running bond with thin black joints and a few black wrought-iron clamps and rivets set into the stone; solid and impassable, filling the square.
prompt_fields.palette: Charcoal slate, dark blue-grey and near-black granite with small cool grey highlights catching upper-left light and dull black iron; dark overall: clearly much darker than a pale stone floor; not brown, not green, not warm.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as a dark solid blocking mass filling its cell, clearly darker and heavier than any floor; distinct from pale Kor'Pul brick and brown rock by its dark cool slate masonry and iron; broad even forms, no holes showing floor, no small scattered objects.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead material filling the whole square with even density; stone courses run straight across; no border, gap, visible floor, cliff face, battlement silhouette, object or cast shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Blocking wall top only. Paint no door, opening, window, stairs, hazard, character, symbol or text.

assets.scope: Vor Pride gothic wall tiles whose south neighbour is not wall/door (the face band); nowhere else.

references.note: Native gothic wall face: dark granite blocks crowned by black iron spikes. Keep the dark masonry with a row of iron spikes and the gothic character.

prompt_fields.subject: One straight free-standing section of a dark gothic keep wall seen from the front and slightly above: dark dressed slate-grey stone blocks in even courses, a row of shallow pointed lancet-arch blind niches along the face, and a crest of short black wrought-iron spikes along the top edge; a solid wall section, wider than tall.
prompt_fields.palette: Charcoal slate, dark blue-grey granite and near-black iron, small cool grey highlights from upper-left light; dark overall, no warm brown, no green.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels, compressed into a thin band, it must read as the dark vertical face of a blocking wall: darker than the floor it stands on, with the pointed niches and spikes as the gothic identity; no bright windows or openings.
prompt_fields.composition: Single horizontal wall section centred, filling most of the width, straight top and bottom edges, the base sitting on an implied ground line; transparent background around it; no floor, ground patch, shadow on the background, door, gate, tower or banner.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Wall face only. Paint no door, window, opening, stairs, hazard, character, symbol or text. Return a native RGBA PNG with real transparency; no white, grey, black or checkerboard background.

grid_contract.sight: Closed blocks sight; open does not.

prompt_fields.subject: One heavy gothic door leaf seen straight from the front: vertical weathered oak planks in a mid honey-brown, bound by two broad black wrought-iron strap hinges with pointed fleur ends and a row of iron studs, a small iron ring handle; a plain rectangular leaf (no arch on top), upright.
prompt_fields.palette: Mid honey-brown and warm grey-brown oak with black iron; the wood clearly lighter than a dark slate wall and darker than a pale stone floor.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels, laid as a narrow band across a doorway, it must read as a wooden door between dark stone walls: warm wood against cool slate, iron straps visible as dark bands; never as a wall block or a bridge.
prompt_fields.composition: Single rectangular door leaf centred, upright, filling most of the height, with transparent margins; no frame, wall, floor, arch, shadow on the background or second leaf.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Door leaf only. Paint no padlock, seal, rune, keyhole glow, stairs, character, symbol or text. Return a native RGBA PNG with real transparency; no white, grey, black or checkerboard background.
